title: ID0414505-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] CCV terminal LED is ON without authentication enabled
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
CCV lights up even if not enabled
Solution:
Update to v9.0.X
R&D ticket: EVC3-8951
FW
v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75 has a bug when you press outlet on the HMI, both card and RFID lights up. See video
